items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Joe Thomas) does not speak in the transcript. The interviewer mentions Zooty in the context of Charlie Creath's band and St. Louis, but provides no evidence of a personal relationship between Joe Thomas and Zooty.

ctx.x: Oh, he worked boats, of course, yes.

He worked for Circus Land and Fate Movable had the other gig ... I think might have been the first time I saw Zooty. And we were so anxious to hear those guys after we'd cut our lawns and did all these kind of things. Monday night was the night that's allowed for Negroes to make it.
